description: This file defines the ForbiddenException class as part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the API V2 exception namespace. It extends the base PHP Exception class and implements a custom ValidationEscapableException interface, providing a specific exception type used for handling forbidden access errors within the API.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to represent HTTP 403 Forbidden errors within the OrangeHRM API, providing a default error message and supporting exception chaining.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ForbiddenException with an optional custom message, error code, and previous exception, defaulting to 'Unauthorized' message.
